Author: Akari
Name: Venue Helper
Punchline: An all-in-one toolkit for FFXIV venue hosts: attendance, raffles, auctions, giveaways, deathroll tournaments, bar games, menus, and quick announcements.
Description:
An all-in-one venue host toolkit. Open with /venuehelper (aliases /vhelp, /vh).

- Venue Counter: a lap counter plus an all-night running total, multiple venues each with their own visitor set, and a lifetime time-in-venue database with per-visit breakdowns.
- Raffle Helper: ticket counts, free/comp tickets, player notes, a configurable house cut, auto-assigned numbers (0-999, shuffleable), clipboard import, trade auto-credit, and a name-only wheel export.
- Auction Helper: target-to-add, sold-to-house (negative) sales, house cut, a date-filtered history, and buyer tracking across alts.
- Giveaway Helper: capture first /random, then highlight the highest, lowest, closest, or exact-match winner.
- DR Tourny Helper: single OR double elimination deathroll brackets with randomized seeding, automatic roll detection, roll-offs, and best-of-3 finals.
- Shout/Yell Helper: pre-written announcements (add/remove as many as you like), each on its own channel, fired with one click.
- Bar Game Helper: build custom roll games (lucky number, range, highest/lowest/closest) with trade-based buy-ins, live roll capture, a pot (fixed or stacking), and one-click rule announcements. Includes survival games (a streak of successes) in three flavors — same number, higher/lower than a set number, or call higher/lower vs the previous roll — with fixed, tiered, or high-score (longest streak wins) payouts, plus manual roll entry for early rollers.
- Menu Helper: a restaurant menu with per-venue menu profiles. Each item has a price and a serve sequence (multi-step emotes/commands with per-step delays, like a macro) that fires when you serve it; tracks the night's sales per menu with export. Plus reusable macro buttons for adverts, menu hand-overs, and the like.

Exports can be written as TXT, CSV, PDF, or XLSX to a folder you choose.
